scripts.render: for l in en ru; do s=$([ $l = en ] && echo '' || echo -ru); remotion render src/index.ts promo-$l ../docs/promo/count-in$s.mp4 --log=error && remotion still src/index.ts poster-$l ../docs/promo/poster$s.jpg --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=85 --scale=0.8333 --log=error || exit 1; done
scripts.render:vertical: for s in card caption dark; do remotion render src/index.ts vertical-$s out/vertical-$s.mp4 --log=error || exit 1; done
